My clan turned to dust.
My brother gone.
My family under the thumb of an abusive uncle and an arrogant cousin who needed a sound beating with a blunt stick.

Deep in the hollow cavern of my chest, past the cracked ribs and rusted meridians, [Kinetic momentum transferred through skeletal alignment with zero waste].
critique: Sanderson/Gosu: Superb kinetic and mechanical arrays, highly disciplined biology and leverage, slightly clinical.

content:
My clan turned to dust.
My brother gone.
My family under the thumb of an abusive uncle and an arrogant cousin who needed a sound beating with a blunt stick.

Deep in the hollow cavern of my chest, past the cracked ribs and rusted meridians, a tiny, stubborn spark of violet light stirred to life.

*The Plum Blossom Sword Heart.*

I smiled into the dark.

*Just you wait, world.*

*You thought the Heaven's Blade Clan was dead?*

*I'm going to drag this sect back from the grave by its hair—and God help anyone who stands in my way.*
critique: Rothfuss/Inoue: Masterful sensory resonance, tragic weight, and rich canonical depth.
